assumptions.fixture: Representative fixed four C0/C6 four-star and C0 five-star; same native craft+6/talent65%cap fixture. No enemy-stat/HP/RNG/action replacement, no mid-fight recovery.
assumptions.entry: Andrius and Azhdaha use public PLACE_ENTER/BOSS_ROUTE. Tartaglia uses unlocked public LIYUE_ARTIFACT_CHALLENGE. Dvalin is isolated native EXPLICIT lifecycle because its real entry is story-only; this is not proof of public fresh-world access.
assumptions.observation: Native public combat actions through the existing helper; wrappers capture enemy executeCard and final native combat state. Phase/passive log witnesses are distinguished from explicit card execution.
assumptions.time: Native 2x presentation ms/1000 +3sec manual action+6sec result.
